reproduction_target: The computational arm: (a) processing of nascent transcription (PRO-seq) libraries through the Dowell-Lab Nascent-Flow Nextflow pipeline; (b) curation of transcriptionally isolated genes and LIET v1.0.0 model fitting to estimate the Pol II disassociation position (mu_T); (c) cross-species ortholog transfer (BUSCO + Progressive Cactus/halLiftover); (d) the statistical tests, base-composition profiles, alignment panels and metagene plots produced in the Jupyter notebook, reproducing Figures 1-4. Wet-lab library preparation (ATAC-seq, cross-species PRO-seq, arsenic PRO-seq) is out of scope (OOS).
granularity_note: Coarse prose-level step list, one step per named tool/analysis invocation in the Methods. 21 computational (C) steps + 6 wet-lab (W, OOS) steps = 27 total. Workflow files exist (Nextflow main.nf in Nascent-Flow and in 3p_Bedgraph_Generation; sbatch + .py + .ipynb in the analysis repo) but were NOT opened: Stage 1 is prose + repo landing page + README prose only. A Stage-2 workflow-derived step list will very likely be finer (Nascent-Flow alone contains many per-tool rules). Step C21 (ATAC-seq read processing) is inferred from a results/figure claim ('ATAC-seq coverage at ...') for which NO computational Methods text exists - it is included deliberately so the undocumented step is visible rather than silently absent from the denominator.

steps.label: Acquisition of publicly available nascent transcription data from the DBNascent repository (8 human cell types: larynx, blood, colon, ovary, lung, kidney, bone; 5 species across 2 cell types: blood, blastocyst)
Meta-sample generation - combining reads from all technical and biological replicates per cell type (basal) and per condition (perturbation), 'using the same methods as previously published [26]'

Cross-species PRO-seq read processing with the Nascent-Flow Nextflow pipeline (https://github.com/Dowell-Lab/Nascent-Flow); genomes hg38, nomLeu3, rheMac10, saiBol1, mm10 from UCSC goldenPath; squirrel monkey contigs JH378105-JH378420 renamed chr1-chr316
Read quality assessment with FastQC v0.11.5 (human, gibbon, rhesus, squirrel monkey) and v0.11.8 (mouse)
Arsenic-experiment PRO-seq read processing with the Nascent-Flow Nextflow pipeline
Read quality assessment with FastQC v0.11.8 (arsenic experiment)
3'-most-position bedGraph generation via the Nextflow pipeline at .../3p_Bedgraph_Generation (main.nf + example sbatch + example sample CSV)

Annotation-isolation gene filter - remove genes with MANE (version 1.4) annotations within 3kb upstream or 20kb downstream plus their overlapping neighbours; add two manually curated gene sets (Stanley et al. 2025 set + a new set on the same criteria)

Coverage (0.001x per gene), complexity (unique/total reads, 0.001x) and gene-length (>7kb) filters; coverage computed on MANE v1.4 transcript annotations with the 5' end truncated by 1/3 of gene length capped at 750bp (gene-filtering.py / pipeline.sbatch)

LIET model fitting, software v1.0.0 - z5 = MANE TSS, z3 = 5' end of the UTR, 5' pad 3kb, 3' pad 20kb (control) / 30kb (run-on-inducing conditions), priors 'the same recommended in the LIET model paper [26]', 3'-end-of-read input

Post-LIET fit-quality and confound filtering - drop high-residual/no-termination fits (0% reads to termination or >95% to a single phase), antisense >=0.005x within +/-3kb of mu_T, coverage >0.001x (>0.0075x for arsenic control/perturbed) within +/-3kb of mu_T
Tfit bidirectional calling within +/-5kb of mu_T to exclude unannotated bidirectionals (tfit_model.sh + tfit-config/)
Ortholog identification with BUSCO version 5.8.1 and intersection with human RefSeq annotations GCF_000001405.40-RS_2023_03, keeping orthologs with >75% coordinate overlap (busco.sbatch)

Cross-species liftOver of MANE-selected human coordinates using the Progressive Cactus multiple-genome aligner / halLiftover; fragments within 5000bp merged per gene, longest merged region retained (Hal-liftover.sbatch, all_species.sbatch)

Technical / measurement variation estimation - fit reproducibility of |mu_T - TCS| between samples to a Normal distribution, take the 95% CI (2 sigma) as measurement error (human 2 sigma = 2993bp, rhesus 2 sigma = 3159bp; larger bound used cross-species)
Binomial tests with scipy.stats.binom.sf on the count of genes outside the 95% CI (1-sided for run-on / shortening, 2-sided for either direction; null 5%)
Hypergeometric enrichment tests with scipy.stats.hypergeom.sf for the upstream T-rich and GC-rich subsets among genes with altered disassociation

Base composition profiling - mean A/T/G/C content per position over mu_T +/- 4kb across all genes, unknown bases (N) distributed evenly over the four bases, counts normalised by total number of sequences (Figures 2-3)
Sequence alignment panel (Figure 3) rendered with AlignIO from Biopython, positions coloured as insertion / deletion / match for the rhesus-human comparison

Metagene profiling (Figure 4) - PRO-seq coverage 1kb upstream to 7kb downstream of the TCS (MANE annotated transcript coordinates), sliding-window binning as in the CDK7-inhibition work [44], minus-strand genes reverse-complemented, bins with <50 total reads excluded, both strands counted

ATAC-seq read processing and chromatin-accessibility coverage profiling (results reference 'ATAC-seq coverage at ...'; author contributions state ATAC-seq data were 'generated, mapped, and quality-controlled') - NO computational Methods text, no named tool, no script in the repository README
Lymphoblastoid cell line culture (COMIRB 08-1276, Translational Nexus Biobank, EBV-immortalised) in RPMI + 20% FBS, pen/strep, 2mM L-glutamine, 5% CO2, 37C

ATAC-seq library preparation (50,000 viable cells, Omni-ATAC-style resuspension/tagmentation with Illumina Tagment DNA Buffer 15027866 + Enzyme 15027865, Zymo D4014 clean-up, NEBNext IIx M0544S amplification, qPCR-determined extra cycles)

Cross-species nuclei isolation (rhesus Mm 290-96, gibbon Ricky, squirrel monkey SML clone 4D8 / ATCC CRL-2311, human GM12878; BSA treatment, three lysis-buffer washes, freezing buffer, snap-freeze at -70C)

Cross-species PRO-seq library preparation (3-16 million nuclei, Biotin-11-CTP run-on, 1% S2 Drosophila spike-in, three streptavidin pull-downs, VRA3/VRA5 adaptors, RT, 13 PCR cycles, AMPure XP clean-up, Qubit + Agilent D1000 QC)
U-2 OS culture and arsenic stress (DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% pen/strep, 20 million cells over five 15cm plates, 500 uM NaAsO2 (Sigma S7400) for 1h before nuclei isolation)
Arsenic-experiment PRO-seq library preparation (10-minute run-on, 3.5 million S2 Drosophila nuclei spike-in, 15 PCR cycles)

The 8 human cell types and 5 species drawn from DBNascent are described by tissue only; no GEO/SRA sample identifiers appear anywhere in the retrievable paper text.
gaps.how_to_close: Retrieve the rendered T1 table (or the supplementary table) and map every meta-sample to explicit GEO/SRA accessions in machine-readable text.

gaps.where: GEO accessions listed in the analysis-repository README (Displacement_Analysis_Barone_2026)
gaps.missing: The newly generated data are NOT yet public. Checked 2026-07-28: GSM9321236 / GSM9321238 (arsenic PRO-seq) - 'is currently private and is scheduled to be released on Nov 22, 2026.'; GSM6716757 / GSM6716755 / GSM6716759 / GSM6716761 (human, gibbon, rhesus, squirrel monkey PRO-seq) - 'is currently private and is scheduled to be released on Dec 01, 2026.'; only the ATAC-seq sample GSM5269423 resolves to a public record. This is a timed embargo, not a documented controlled-access (DAC) path, so it scores as accidental gating (Data=1), not as legitimate controlled access.
gaps.how_to_close: Re-check the accessions after the stated release dates; until then no Stage-2 execution against the authors' own inputs is possible for 12 of the 13 new samples.

gaps.where: Results / Figure 2 ('ATAC-seq coverage at ...') and Author Contributions ('J.F.C. generated, mapped, and quality-controlled ATAC-seq data')
gaps.missing: There is no computational Methods text for ATAC-seq read processing at all - no aligner, no peak/coverage tool, no parameters - and the repository README lists no ATAC-seq directory. The ATAC-seq bench protocol is documented; the analysis that turns those reads into the plotted accessibility signal is not. Scored as step C21 (NI).
gaps.how_to_close: Add an ATAC-seq data-processing subsection naming the pipeline (likely a Dowell-Lab ATAC pipeline) and deposit or link the script.

Only FastQC (v0.11.5 / v0.11.8), LIET (v1.0.0), BUSCO (v5.8.1), MANE (v1.4) and RefSeq (GCF_000001405.40-RS_2023_03) are pinned in prose (gap 2a for the unpinned set).

gaps.where: All four GitHub citations in Methods
gaps.missing: Floating code pointers (gap 2b). The paper cites https://github.com/Dowell-Lab/Nascent-Flow (default branch master) and https://github.com/Dowell-Lab/Disassociation_Analysis/tree/main/... - branch paths, never a tag or commit SHA. A release DOES exist on the analysis repo landing page (tag v1.0.0, 'PolII_Displacement_Analysis', published 2026-05-21) and on Nascent-Flow (tag v1, 2025-03-01), but neither is cited in the paper, and the analysis-repo URL printed in the paper has since been renamed (301 redirect).
gaps.how_to_close: Cite the v1.0.0 release tag (or a commit SHA / Zenodo DOI) in Methods rather than /tree/main.

gaps.where: Methods - reference resources consumed by C3, C5, C8, C13, C14
gaps.missing: External reference resources are pinned only in prose, and unevenly: MANE v1.4 and RefSeq GCF_000001405.40-RS_2023_03 are pinned; UCSC goldenPath genome builds (hg38, nomLeu3, rheMac10, saiBol1, mm10) are named but carry no download date, patch level or checksum; the BUSCO lineage dataset used with BUSCO v5.8.1 is not named at all. Whether the workflow fetches any of these itself (class A) or consumes a user-supplied local path (class B) or a rolling resource (class C) CANNOT be decided at Stage 1 - env_capture_class is 'n/a' for every step by protocol.
gaps.how_to_close: Stage-2 code read of Nascent-Flow config + the sbatch scripts to assign env_capture_class A/B/C.

gaps.where: Methods - Data Processing Across Species / Data Processing Arsenic Experiment
gaps.missing: The primary read-processing is externalised to a separate repository (Nascent-Flow) with its own, differently-versioned dependency set; the paper carries no record of which Nascent-Flow revision or which internal tool versions (HISAT2, samtools, BEDTools, bbmap, preseq, RSeQC, MultiQC ...) produced the CRAM/bedGraph inputs consumed by every downstream step.
gaps.how_to_close: Record the Nascent-Flow commit/tag and the pipeline's emitted software-versions report alongside the deposited data.

gaps.where: Nascent-Flow README (repo landing page) and the analysis repo's .sbatch scripts
gaps.missing: Environment is hardcoded to the authors' HPC. The Nascent-Flow README instructs: 'edit the appropriate config file, e.g. conf/slurm_grch38.config, to ensure the proper paths are set for genome reference files and other executables (look for all mentions of COMPLETE_*)', and lists dependencies as Fiji-cluster module loads plus 'pip3 install ... --user'. The analysis repo ships '*.sbatch' submission scripts. Acknowledgements confirm the BioFrontiers HPC dependency.
gaps.how_to_close: Ship a container or a resolved environment lock plus a site-independent profile.

gaps.where: Methods - LIET Model Inputs and Prior Selection (step C10)
gaps.missing: LIET is a Bayesian fitting procedure with priors; no random seed, chain count, or convergence criterion is reported, so per-gene mu_T estimates are stochastic. Caps C10 at RI with subflag 'distributional-only' even if everything else were captured.
gaps.how_to_close: Report the seed (and show it is consumed) or specify the tolerance within which mu_T is expected to match.

gaps.where: Methods - 'Publicly Available Data' and meta-sample generation (steps C1, C2)
gaps.missing: DBNascent is named as the source repository but is not versioned, not linked by URL in the Methods text, and no query/selection script is deposited; meta-sample generation is delegated to 'the same methods as previously published [26]' with no script in the analysis repository.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the DBNascent query and the meta-sample merge script, and state the DBNascent snapshot date/version.

gaps.where: Methods - Chromatin Accessibility Assay (ATAC-seq), Cross Species Nascent Run-On Assay (PRO-seq), Arsenic Experiment
gaps.missing: Not a defect - 6 bench steps (W1-W6) are wet-lab and excluded from |S| by scope-split. They are well documented at protocol level (reagent catalogue numbers, buffer compositions, cycle counts).
